bio: Head to the first floor of Hotel Rigiblick to experience Comfort Fine Dining. The contemporary seasonal cuisine, built on classical foundations, is proposed in the form of two set menus: the Kleine Wanderung (three courses) or the Grosse Überquerung (four to five courses). A selection of Swiss wines is available. Dinner service begins at 7pm. The excellent food is complemented by the modern, elegant decor and attentive, friendly service. Thanks to its beautiful location above Zurich, the one-of-a-kind terrace surrounded by greenery is a summer highlight! Tip: Parking facilities inside the building. And you might like to know that the Theater Rigiblick is right next door....
